properties.description: Successful Copilot Studio BotAuthUpdate on a known enabled agent; reports configuration change without asserting weakened authentication.
properties.displayName: AI Agent | Registered agent authentication configuration changed
properties.query:
let Agents = _GetWatchlist('AIAgentInventory')
    | where tolower(tostring(Enabled)) == 'true'
    | project AgentId = tolower(tostring(AgentId))
    | where isnotempty(AgentId) | distinct AgentId;
PowerPlatformAdminActivity
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| where EventOriginalType == 'BotUpdateOperation-BotAuthUpdate' and EventResult == 'Succeeded'
| extend AgentId = tolower(coalesce(tostring(Properties.BotId), tostring(PropertyCollection.BotId))),
         ActorUPN = iff(tostring(ActorName) contains '@', tolower(tostring(ActorName)), '')
| where isnotempty(AgentId) and isnotempty(EventOriginalUid)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by EventOriginalUid
| join kind=inner Agents on AgentId
| project TimeGenerated, AgentId, ActorUPN, EnvironmentId,
          Evidence = tostring(bag_pack('eventId', EventOriginalUid, 'operation', EventOriginalType, 'actorId', ActorUserId, 'assessment', 'Authentication configuration changed; weakening not established')),
          CorrelationQuality = 'configuration', AccountCustomEntity = ActorUPN
